messages.text: Quick wins from today's technical SEO session. Root cause found for the two FAQ schema warnings in Google Search Console: the accordion CSS was hiding all FAQ answers from Google (max-height: 0), which made them ineligible for rich results. Fixed this on both /therapy-red-bluff-ca and /online-therapy-california — answers are now permanently visible in the HTML, which is what Google needs to index them. Sitemap was resubmitted to Google to trigger a re-crawl of both pages. Expect the warnings to clear once Google processes the new crawl (usually a few days to a couple weeks). Also flagged: /online-therapy-california is getting 9,441 impressions/month at position #29 with only 9 clicks (0.1% CTR) — a title tag rewrite is the next lever to pull on that page.

May data is in. 154 organic clicks from 37,684 impressions — clicks are actually up slightly from April (146) and average position improved significantly from 34.0 to 25.2. Impressions are down from April's 49,026, which reflects seasonal variation in broad query volume for 'online therapy' and 'couples therapy' terms. Brand terms remain dominant at position 1. The standout opportunity this month: 'online therapy' is driving 5,750 impressions at position 16.7 with almost no clicks — one strong content improvement away from page 1. On deck for June: Red Bluff hero fix (PHW-148), GBP optimization pass, and the first service page expansion targeting anxiety therapy California.

April 2026 stats are in! Parish Health and Wellness received 146 organic clicks from 43,827 impressions in Google Search over the last 30 days — up 8% in clicks and 2.3% in impressions from our baseline. Your average position improved slightly from 36.9 to 36.5. Top keyword "parish health and wellness" holds strong at #1 with 51 clicks. We also spotted two high-opportunity keywords with significant impressions but low clicks — "online therapy" (2,936 impressions, position 31) and "online therapist" (845 impressions, position 40) — both added to tracking. These are prime targets for content improvements next month.
